attribution.note: Zitron states the forecast directly in his own voice.

semantics.note: The surrounding passage supplies the 2023 start date. The normalization preserves the definite forecast, threshold and deadline without specifying an accounting basis.

contract.note: The contract acknowledges unspecified accounting and year conventions without imposing either. Its assertion that interpretation determines the result is not established: the packet contains no figures showing whether those choices change the outcome.

output.rationale: The deadline has passed, but the packet contains no expenditure figures or material counterevidence. The uncollected secondary source cannot establish the outcome. Neither the threshold result nor the effect of the accounting and year ambiguities is demonstrated.
